ctaHeading: Let's Design Your Perfect Space in Fitzroy
aboutText: Located in Fitzroy, ESDA Studio specialises in creating integrated architecture and landscape designs that are efficient, durable, and environmentally responsive. Our approach ensures every project is tailored to the local environment and client needs. With a focus on sustainability, we blend form and function to create spaces that stand the test of time.
servicesText: At ESDA Studio, we offer comprehensive design services that merge architecture with landscape. Our expertise covers everything from initial concept to final implementation, ensuring spaces that are both functional and beautiful. We work closely with clients to bring their vision to life.

services.title: Landscape Design

services.title: Architectural Design
services.desc: Developing building concepts that are sustainable, efficient, and in harmony with the surrounding landscape.

services.title: Sustainable Design Solutions
services.desc: Incorporating eco-friendly materials and practices to reduce environmental impact and enhance longevity.

services.title: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.desc: Designing patios, gardens, and outdoor areas that extend living spaces and promote relaxation.

services.title: Garden Planning
services.desc: Strategic layout and plant selection to create low-maintenance, beautiful gardens suited to local conditions.

services.title: Environmental Consulting
services.desc: Advising on sustainable practices and regulatory compliance for landscape and architecture projects.
